words.gloss_range: delayed sequential particle that carries the discourse from the completed planning phase into the hardship phase
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) opens the ayah as delayed sequence: the hard years come after the completed protocol of 12:47, not as an immediate or isolated follow-on. As the first word, it makes the ayah a darker next phase in Yūsuf's continuing interpretation, and the held m-sound reinforces the staged turn.

topics.headline: delayed phase pivot after abundance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the famine phase is temporally staged after the completed planning phase rather than merely appended.
topics.reason: The opening particle is constrained by the sequential clause and the 12:47-to-12:48 discourse window.

topics.headline: opening continuation into a darker scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 12:48 as continuation of the previous agrarian instruction, with the speech turning from planning to consuming hardship.
topics.reason: The first word attaches the ayah to the prior instruction and prepares the arrival verb.

topics.headline: geminated sound supports delay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transition as held and weighted, matching the particle’s delayed-sequence force.
topics.reason: The sound observation supports the syntactic delayed-sequence reading.

words.root_gloss_range: root range of coming, arriving, coming upon, and in other forms giving or bringing; local Form I selects arrival rather than causative giving

words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتِي}} ({{tr:yaʾtī}}) makes the hard years arrive as a future phase before any object is consumed. Its Form I and intransitive local use separate onset from {{ar:يَأْكُلْنَ}} ({{tr:yaʾkulna}}); the singular masculine agreement looks forward to the numeral subject, while the later feminine plural verb reveals the implied years. The arriving subject is the abstract years themselves, so conditions take the first agency position before human action returns later. The hostile coming-upon pressure survives as a narrowed color of onset, and the wording starts the repeated phase formula that returns in 12:49.

topics.headline: arrival before consumption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first brings the years onstage and only later assigns them consuming action.
topics.reason: The local verb has the seven as subject, no direct object, and Form I arrival rather than Form IV giving.

topics.headline: arrival formula repeated in the next phase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the famine as one panel in a serial interpretation because the same arrival-after-that frame returns in 12:49.
topics.reason: The row family supplies the repeated 12:48-12:49 formula, and the local phrase licenses the phase-panel reading.

topics.headline: arrival colored as hostile onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the coming years as an overtaking hardship, while the grammar still keeps actual consumption for the later eating verb.
topics.reason: Lexical evidence allows calamitous coming-upon language, but local syntax keeps this verb as arrival, not direct devouring.

topics.headline: hamza marks the onset

topics.reason: The phonetic observation is retained as support for the marked onset.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: temporal noun governed in the local phrase

topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the preposition to govern the temporal noun and supports source/onset rather than partitive force.

words.gloss_range: construct temporal noun meaning after that specific prior phase
words.root_gloss_range: posteriority range covering after, behind, and distance; local syntax selects temporal after while preserving a rearward image as color
words.prose: {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}) is not a free-floating later; as a genitive construct it leans on {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) and makes the hard years come after that specific prior period. The root's rearward image is narrowed into temporal posteriority, so abundance feels placed behind the new horizon. The same after-that hinge helps the 12:48 opening pair with the next phase in 12:49; across the wider formula it can mark divergent turns such as 2:64, while here it marks hardship after abundance inside Surah 12's sequence of state changes.

words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) completes the temporal chain by pointing back to the seven-year protocol of 12:47. Its distance is not vague remoteness: it identifies the abundance phase as definite and already set behind the famine scene before {{ar:سَبْعٌ}} ({{tr:sabʿun}}) appears.

words.gloss_range: bare nominative numeral serving as subject, with years omitted but recoverable

words.prose: {{ar:سَبْعٌ}} ({{tr:sabʿun}}) is a bare nominative count that functions as the subject of arrival, while the counted noun years is omitted and recovered from 12:47 and the later feminine plural agreement. The count remains exact, not vague fullness; the same number can be given as gift elsewhere (15:87), but here it arrives as affliction. Because the same sound family includes a rare beast-of-prey noun, the devouring context lets a predatory overtone survive only as narrowed pressure; the word still means seven. Across 12:43, 12:46, and 12:47, the repeated seven moves from dream image into interpreted time and into the seven-plus-eating network.

topics.headline: bare seven with omitted years
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word compresses seven years into a bare count while grammar still lets the omitted years be recovered.
topics.reason: The numeral is subject of arrival and later feminine plural agreement confirms the implied counted noun.

topics.headline: beast overtone beside devouring years

topics.reason: The rare beast noun supplies only sound-pressure because occurrence and syntax keep the local word as the numeral.

topics.headline: exact count in the dream-interpretation chain

topics.reason: Same-surah references preserve the repeated seven structure while local syntax keeps the number exact.

topics.headline: tanwīn links count to severity and remnant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the bare count joined by cadence to the severe adjective and later small remnant.
topics.reason: The sound row supports the word-level cadence without changing the grammatical analysis.

words.root_gloss_range: range of tightening, strengthening, intensity, and severity; local adjective selects severe hardness for years
words.prose: {{ar:شِدَادٌ}} ({{tr:shidādun}}) completes the subject phrase by making the implied years collectively severe and unbounded in harshness before the ayah turns to devouring. The root's tightening and binding image makes the famine feel constrictive, not simply lean. Its postposed position lets the count land first and the harsh quality arrive as the decisive qualification; echoes such as Yūsuf's maturity in 12:22, punishment-severity language (42:16; 34:46), or the seven strong heavens in 78:12 remain comparative background, not the local sense.

topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the implied years and its root field supports constrictive severity.

Its feminine plural ending identifies the implied years, and {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) supplies the object: what the addressees had advanced. The eating root is narrowed from ordinary eating to resource depletion, with the inanimate years personified as consumers. The reported third-person standard is preserved over the addressed-person variant, and the root flips the boundary from human eating in 12:47 to years devouring in 12:48, with the dream's consuming image in 12:46 now interpreted as time.

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) does not name grain directly; it routes the object through the relative clause {{ar:قَدَّمْتُمْ}} ({{tr:qaddamtum}}). Before the exception, it casts the consumed scope as whatever the addressees advanced. The embedded past action sits inside a future prophecy frame: what has been advanced is the object the coming years will devour. It also sets up the later {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}): first what was advanced is consumed, then what is guarded becomes the source of the small survivor.

words.prose: {{ar:قَدَّمْتُمْ}} ({{tr:qaddamtum}}) names the addressees' completed act of sending provisions forward before the hard years consume them, and the following lām phrase routes that advanced object toward those years. Its perfect tense sits inside a future famine frame, and the Form II shape makes the preparation deliberate rather than accidental. The root's frontness and footstep image makes storage feel like resources moved ahead in time. The near-sounding variant is useful only as contrast: the standard word keeps the frame temporal and economic, not offering-nearness. Wider what-you-send-ahead echoes such as 2:110 and 5:80 sharpen the accountability shape, while the local object is material provision.

It introduces {{ar:قَلِيلًا}} ({{tr:qalīlan}}) and licenses its accusative exception role as the connected exception from what the years consume; a row that pressed a disconnected exception is narrowed because the attachment evidence makes the exception come out of the consumed provisions. The particle also repeats the exception frame from 12:47, but with a changed function: there it limits human eating, here it protects what escapes the years.

words.prose: {{ar:قَلِيلًا}} ({{tr:qalīlan}}) is the little that survives: an accusative, indefinite adjective used substantively after the exception particle. Its smallness is unquantified but not vague; it is the survival threshold drawn from what the addressees guard. Its -an ending makes the exception land differently from the earlier -un cadence of the count and severity. The same phrase frame appears in 12:47, where the little is what humans may eat, but in 12:48 the little is what must remain protected from the devouring years.

words.prose: {{ar:تُحْصِنُونَ}} ({{tr:tuḥṣinūn}}) closes the ayah with ongoing human guarding. It is imperfect, second-person plural, and transitive with the reserve recoverable as object, so protection continues after prior preparation has already been consumed down to a remnant. Form IV makes the addressees cause security, not merely find a secure store, and it stands out against the root family's frequent protected-status forms. The root's fortress and protected-inaccessibility field is narrowed to material provisions under famine: the broader protection contexts in 59:2 and 24:33 help explain the safeguarding image, while the local sense is active fortifying of grain or reserve. The protection root answers the arrival and severity fields of this ayah, and its hard consonant texture plus final -ūn land on the addressed community's action. Because this is the final word, the ayah does not end on the years' devouring but on human protective responsibility.

topics.reason: The imperfect 2mp form keeps the guarding ongoing and tied to the same addressees.

topics.reason: The root field supports protected inaccessibility, but local grammar and object recovery narrow it to material reserves.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequential construction "then ... after that," the feminine plural eater, the advance made "for them," and the exception for what is fortified.
baseline_models.mechanism: A later interval is personified as an arriving consumer. Prior surplus is transferred forward as its sustenance, while enclosure removes a small portion from ordinary circulation.

activation_trace.role: Literal arrival gives the future interval agency as an incoming demand.
Literal succession establishes a staged handoff from one economic state to the next.
Hardness, hunger, and distress supply the pressure that accelerates depletion.
Consumption of property extends eating from ingestion to expenditure of accumulated resources.
Advancing something ahead makes present production an intentional transfer to future need.
Enclosure within a fortifying boundary creates the protected exception to consumption.

changed_reading.before: Seven severe years follow and use up stored food, apart from a little kept back.
changed_reading.after: The verse models an intertemporal transfer system: future pressure actively consumes what the present advances, so survival depends on removing a small reserve from the normal circuit of use.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus places the root س ب ع beside severity and a feminine plural act of eating.
baseline_models.mechanism: The numbered seven carries a simultaneous predator image. The hard periods become a coordinated pack, prior provisions become prey, and fortification becomes refuge rather than mere accumulation.

activation_trace.role: The literal number fixes the sevenfold duration while permitting a second branch image to overlay it.
The predator branch turns the seven units into devouring agents rather than neutral calendar labels.
The image of a forceful charge supplies the pack's mode of onset.
The prey prepared for eating makes the advanced stores vulnerable quarry.
A surrounding stronghold supplies the spatial counterforce to predation.

changed_reading.before: The seven are a count of difficult years.
changed_reading.after: The count remains literal but is made animate: the seven arrive like hard predators, and only provision placed behind a real boundary escapes becoming prey.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The advanced provision is explicitly directed "for them," giving the severe periods beneficiary-like status.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival, tribute, advance, and property consumption combine into an allocative reading. Future periods make claims on present wealth; the protected little is a ring-fenced amount that cannot be paid out.

activation_trace.role: The tribute image casts the arriving period as a claimant to whom resources are rendered.
Taking or spending wealth makes the years' eating an economic drawdown.
A prior benefaction frames stored produce as a contribution credited ahead of need.
Smallness defines the deliberately limited amount exempted from the future claim.
Fortified custody functions as a fiscal ring fence around the exempt reserve.

changed_reading.before: The years naturally consume whatever food happens to have been stored.
changed_reading.after: The years are treated as future claimants for whom present wealth is budgeted; resilience requires both planned expenditure and an inviolable reserve.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exception is not all that is fortified but "a little from what you fortify."
baseline_models.mechanism: The grammar partitions protected stock into a spendable body and a small surviving core. Fortification therefore manages controlled depletion rather than promising preservation of the whole store.

activation_trace.role: Resource expenditure establishes that most accumulated provision remains available for necessary use.
Literal smallness identifies a narrow residual core rather than general abundance.
Fortified containment explains how the residual core is kept outside the depletion path.

changed_reading.before: Fortification means trying to preserve as much produce as possible.
changed_reading.after: Fortification is selective reserve design: most stock is meant to sustain the crisis, while a deliberately small core must remain inaccessible to consumption.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier paired visions escalate from bread carried openly above the head to the head itself being eaten by birds. This makes exposure a loss mechanism and sharpens fortification as control of placement and access.

activation_trace.role: A visibly carried load supplies provision that is transported but not enclosed.
The upper location makes the load conspicuous and externally reachable.
Literal bread supplies the concrete edible provision lost through exposure.
The prey image converts exposed food into an object already available to a consumer.
Mobile birds embody consumers able to reach an unprotected resource.
The repeated prey branch escalates consumption from carried bread to the exposed person.
The literal head marks the exposed upper boundary where loss reaches the bearer.
Fortified enclosure answers the earlier pattern by changing accessibility rather than merely increasing quantity.

structural_cues: 12:36 and 12:41 repeat bird consumption at an exposed upper location, first of provision and then of the bearer.
12:48 makes the protected category the sole exception to eating.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated exposed objects and mobile eaters; the reader supplies the arrow that exposure enables loss and enclosure blocks access. A live alternative is that the prison visions only predict individual fates and do not establish a general storage law.

changed_reading.before: A sufficient quantity of stored food survives because it was accumulated.
changed_reading.after: Survival depends on architecture of access: provision left externally available becomes prey, while provision whose placement is fortified can escape the same consumer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Interpretive news is promised before food arrives, later recovered after a long interval, translated from image to meaning, and enacted as sustained labor. The advance in 12:48 therefore includes the timing discipline that turns foresight into provision.

activation_trace.role: A delivered report makes actionable knowledge arrive ahead of the event it concerns.
Temporal precedence supplies the planning window in which knowledge can alter later material conditions.
Crossing from a vision's surface to its meaning supplies the conversion from sign to forecast.
Recall after forgetting reactivates information whose practical value had been delayed.
An intervening span makes the delay itself part of the causal sequence.
Persistent effort converts the interpreted warning into a repeated production practice.
Advancing ahead gathers forecast and labor into anticipatory provision.

structural_cues: 12:37 explicitly orders interpretation before the arrival of food.
The sequence from vision to recall to sustained cultivation precedes the focus sequence from advance to consumption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies precedence, delayed recall, interpretation, and sustained work; the reader supplies the arrow that foresight becomes material only through timely enactment. A live alternative is that "what you advanced" refers narrowly to crop already stored, without carrying an epistemic layer.

changed_reading.before: What is advanced consists only of grain physically accumulated before the hard years.
changed_reading.after: The advanced provision is the material result of timely interpretation: knowledge must arrive, be retained, and be converted into repeated practice before the crisis arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lean bodies eat fat bodies while dry growth is paired against green growth. The hard interval is thus not only later scarcity; it is a deficit state that consumes the embodied condition of prior abundance.

activation_trace.role: Fatness embodies accumulated surplus in the very condition of the earlier bodies.
Resource consumption turns the relation between the two groups into a transfer of stored abundance.
Emaciation and lost fat personify the later deficit that draws down prior surplus.
Fresh green growth supplies the productive state placed in opposition to desiccation.
Dried vegetation supplies the material state of exhausted productivity.
The focus repeats expenditure as the operative relation between later severity and earlier abundance.

structural_cues: 12:43 and 12:46 repeat the same eater/eaten and green/dry oppositions.
12:48 replaces the dream bodies with a direct relation between severe periods and prior provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lean eaters, fat consumed bodies, and green/dry counterparts; the reader supplies the arrow that deficit metabolizes embodied surplus. A live alternative is that the paired images encode only duration and severity, without a general transfer mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Later years consume discrete stores accumulated during earlier years.
changed_reading.after: Later deficit consumes the embodied surplus of the prior productive state itself; the verse tracks conversion of abundance into crisis-maintenance, not merely chronological replacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sustained cultivation is followed by cutting, deliberate leaving, retention in the ear, and minimal eating. Fortification becomes a material-shell protocol: preserve grain within its existing enclosure and ration what crosses into consumption.

activation_trace.role: Cultivation and growth supply the productive inflow from which a reserve can be formed.
Persistent effort makes reserve formation a sustained practice rather than a single harvest event.
Cutting the crop marks the point at which productive growth becomes managed stock.
Deliberate leaving supplies the withholding action that interrupts immediate use.
The grain ear supplies the intact biological container in which the harvested material remains.
A small eating allotment limits how much stock crosses from enclosure into use.
Literal ingestion is the controlled outflow against which the retained crop is protected.
Fortified containment names the protective function performed by leaving grain in its ear.

structural_cues: 12:47 orders production, harvest, leaving in the ear, and restricted eating.
12:48 repeats little/eating but changes the protected remainder into the exception after general consumption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intact ears, deliberate leaving, and rationed eating; the reader supplies the arrow that the ear functions as the fortifying boundary named next. A live alternative is that the ear is only an ordinary storage instruction and does not exhaust the broader force of fortification.

changed_reading.before: Fortification is generic storage in a secure place.
changed_reading.after: Fortification is a concrete preservation design: keep harvested grain inside its native shell and govern the small stream released for consumption.

context_deltas.mechanism: A distinct year then arrives with both rain/rescue and renewed pressing. This reclassifies the little protected amount as continuity capacity: the reserve can bridge a closed consumption cycle to a reopened productive cycle.

activation_trace.role: A new arrival marks a regime change after the sevenfold depletion.
The singular annual cycle distinguishes recovery from the preceding seven-unit block.
Life-giving rain restores the external condition for production.
Aid in distress adds a social recovery sense alongside meteorological renewal.
Pressing until liquid is released signals the return of processable abundance.
Extracted yield makes renewed production operational rather than merely promised.
The small remainder supplies the minimum continuity stock carried across the closed interval.
Fortified custody preserves the option to reconnect depletion with later renewal.

structural_cues: 12:49 repeats the arrival-after-that construction but replaces seven severe consumers with one year of rescue and pressing.
The focus's exception immediately precedes the recovery reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a protected remainder followed by rain/rescue and pressing; the reader supplies the arrow that continuity stock helps bridge to renewed production. A live alternative is that all material used in 12:49 is newly produced after rain, so the reserve only sustains life until recovery and does not cause it.

changed_reading.before: The protected little is merely the final food left when the crisis ends.
changed_reading.after: The protected little is option-preserving continuity stock: it carries the system through depletion until productive extraction becomes possible again.

context_deltas.mechanism: Appointment, capacity, trust, treasuries, productive land, and guarding scale the focus from household prudence to public stewardship. Fortification is an institutional practice requiring a competent custodian over shared reserves.

activation_trace.role: Capacity and empowerment supply the authority needed to execute reserve policy.
Security and trust supply the reliability required of the reserve's custodian.
Appointment into a defined condition turns preservation from advice into an office.
Safekeeping and securing goods supply the institutional storage function.
The keeper image identifies accountable human custody as part of the store itself.
Productive land scales the mechanism to the resource base of the whole territory.
Active guarding makes preservation an ongoing duty rather than a passive container.
Fortification gathers authority, custody, and guarded storage into the focus's protected exception.

structural_cues: The forecast moves from second-person plural preparation in 12:47-48 to appointment over the land's treasuries in 12:54-55.
The custodian is characterized by both guarding and knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies office, empowerment, trust, treasuries, land, and guarding; the reader supplies the arrow that resilience depends on governance quality and accountable custody. A live alternative is that the appointment is a biographical consequence of the forecast rather than part of 12:48's semantic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse advises individuals to keep enough grain for their own future.
changed_reading.after: The verse also sketches public resilience infrastructure: shared surplus must be fortified through empowered, trusted, knowledgeable stewardship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the crisis through a hydraulic material analogy rather than asserting that the seven are literal floods. It remains anchored in the focus's incoming-flood, corrosion, and fortress branches and gains contrast from the beneficial rain immediately after. Downstream prose should present it only as a flow-and-barrier model, not as a meteorological identification.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines an incoming event, resource-eating decay, and fortified containment; 12:49 reverses hostile depletion into life-giving water.

activation_trace.role: An incoming flood from elsewhere supplies a model of crisis arriving across a boundary.
Corrosion and decay translate eating into material erosion under sustained exposure.
A surrounding fort supplies the barrier that preserves a remainder against the hostile flow.
Beneficial rain reverses the water domain from destructive influx to productive renewal.

changed_reading.before: The hard years are only a temporal block that consumes food.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the crisis behaves like an incoming erosive flow: most stock lies in its path, a barrier protects a core, and the same flow domain later reverses into renewal.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yedi sayısını çekirdek alır; yedide bir payı, bir topluluğun yedincisi olmayı, yetmişi, yedi günlük ya da yedi aşamalı dönemleri ve yedi kez yapılan işlemleri bu çekirdeğe bağlar. Bazı kullanımlarda yedi, kesin sayımın ötesinde çoğaltma ve pekiştirme de bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın sayı ve kesir anlamlarını korurken hafta, yedi tur, yedi gece ve yedi kez yapma gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımları ayrı yüzler olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Yedi sayısını ve bu sayıya göre kurulan pay, sıra, dönem, çevrim ya da yineleme ilişkilerini anlatır. Bazı bağlı kullanımlarda tam yediyle sınırlı kalmadan çoğaltma ve pekiştirme işlevi kazanır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, altıdan sonra ve sekizden önce gelen yedi sayısı ile bir grubun yedincisi olma durumudur.
Bir bütünün yedi eşit parçasından biri ile altmıştan sonra gelen yetmişlik onluk da sayı çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
Yedi günlük hafta ve yedi aşamalı çevrimler, sayının zaman ya da hareket düzenine uygulanmasıdır.
Develerin belirli bir yedi temelli aralıkla suya götürülmesi, sayıya bağlı özel bir sulama düzenidir.
Yedi tur atma, yedi gecede okuma, yedi gece kalma, yedinci günde işlem yapma ve yedi kez yıkama yalnız kendi kalıplarında geçerlidir.
Yediyle türetilen kimi ifadeler, kesin bir sayım yerine kat kat artırma ya da çokluk bildirebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çerçevesi yedi sayısıdır; kesir, sıra, hafta, yetmiş, yedi aşamalı uygulamalar ve özel sulama düzeni bu sayıdan türetilir. Toplu kanıt ayrıca yedinin bazı bağlamlarda kesin sınır değil, çoğaltma ve pekiştirme aracı olabildiğini gösterir.

Ancak sınıfın sınırı her etçil hayvanı kapsamaz; bazı hayvanların dışarıda bırakılması açıkça belirtilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın yırtıcı hayvan anlamı çekirdektir; yer, yem etme, sürüye saldırma, yavrusunu yitirme ve çobanın uğradığı olay yalnız ilgili yapılarda geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlara ya da başka hayvanlara saldıran, onları yakalayıp yiyen dişli yırtıcı hayvanı anlatır. Bu çekirdekten dişisi, yoğun bulunduğu yer, avına uğrayan canlı ya da sürü ve yırtıcıya yem etme gibi bağlı durumlar türetilir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, insanlara veya hayvanlara saldırarak onları avlayan dişli yırtıcı hayvandır.
Dişi yırtıcı, bazı kullanımlarda özellikle dişi aslan, ayrı bir biçimle belirtilir.
Yırtıcıların çok bulunduğu arazi, hayvan çekirdeğinin mekâna uygulanmış uzantısıdır.
Bir şeyi yırtıcıya yem etmek ve kurdun sürüyü parçalayıp yemesi, avlanma olayına bağlı eylemlerdir.
Yavrusu yırtıcı tarafından yenmiş dişi hayvan ile sürüsüne yırtıcı saldırmış çoban, olayın etkilediği katılımcıları belirtir.
Sınıfın kapsamı saldırıp avlama ölçütüne bağlıdır; bazı aktarımlar tilkiyi ve saldırgan sayılmayan sırtlanı bu kapsamın dışında tutar.

Aynı kökten gelen sınırlı yapılarda bir şeyi hafifletmenin karşıtı olarak artırma, bir işe gücü yetme ya da yetmeme, bütün gücünü harcama ve güçlü bir bineğe sahip olma anlatılır.

Belirli bir ad, hafifletmenin karşıtı olan artırma ve ağırlaştırma işlemini bildirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أكل العرض، الغيبة، أكل لحوم الناس، وذو أكلة أو إكلة في الناس.
يدخل فيه آكلت بين القوم، الإيكال بين الناس، والمؤكل بمعنى النمام أو من يحرش ويفسد.
يدخل فيه أكلتني أو آكلتني ما لم آكل بمعنى ادعيته علي، وآكلتك فلانا بمعنى أمكنته منه.
يدخل فيه قولهم أكلة رأس للجماعة القليلة التي يشبعها رأس واحد.
يدخل فيه ثوب ذو أكل لكثرة الغزل والقوة، ورجل ذو أكل بمعنى الرأي والعقل.
يدخل فيه المئكلة والإناء والقصعة والبرمة والموضع أو المصدر الذي يؤكل منه.
يدخل فيه آكلة اللحم بمعنى السكين أو العصا المحددة أو السياط المشبهة بالنار في آثارها.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, başkasının bakımına ve geçimine yük olan kişiyi çekirdek yapar; yetim, yakın desteği bulunmayan kişi ve bakmakla yükümlü olunan kimse bu alanda sayılır. Dal kullanılabilir, ancak bütün bu kişileri özleri gereği değersizleştiren bir niteleme gibi okunmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad bağımlı kişiyi veya yükü bildirir; akrabaların kişiye yük olması gibi okumalar yalnız verilen söz öbeklerine bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bakımı, geçimi veya taşınması başkasının sorumluluğuna yük olan kişi ya da şeydir. Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem de ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi gibi geleneksel adlandırmalar ile akrabaların birine bağımlı hale gelmesi bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şeyin bakım, geçim veya taşıma bakımından başkasına yük olması çekirdektir.
Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi kanıta bağlı özel referanslardır.
Taşınan tapınma nesnesi ve geçimi bir kişiye kalan akrabalar, bağımlılık ilişkisinin söz öbeğine bağlı örnekleridir.
Kaynak anlatımında ağır tabiatlı kişi ve başkası adına iş gören kişi de bu adlandırmanın çevresinde anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, geçimi veya bakımı bir başkasının üzerinde kalan bağımlı kişi ya da şeydir. Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi ve hem çocuğu hem ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi öne çıkan özel durumlar, taşınan nesne ile geçimi üstlenilen akrabalar ise ilişkiyi somutlaştıran kullanımlardır. Bir kaynak, ağır tabiatlı kişiyi ve başkası adına iş gören kişiyi de bu adlandırma çevresinde anar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimdeki öncül etki ve mevki ile iyi ya da kötü nitelemeli yapılar ve kişi adlandırmaları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Yalın kullanım, önceden gerçekleşmiş bir işin bıraktığı etkiyi, iyiliği, hizmeti veya seçkin konumu bildirir. Nitelemeli yapılarda bu etki iyi bir paye ya da kötü bir geçmiş olarak özelleşir; kişi adlandırmalarında önderlik ve saygınlık öne çıkar.

facets.statement: Önceden yapılmış bir işin kişi lehine veya aleyhine kalan etkisini ve önceliğini belirtir.
Olumlu bağlamda geçmiş iyilik, hizmet, kalıcı güzel iz, şeref ve yüksek mevki anlamlarını taşır.
Kişi adlandırmalarında başta bulunma, hükümdarlık, önderlik veya saygın kişi olma anlamına yönelir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak tabanı önceden gelen etki ve önceliktir; bu taban iyilikte güzel iz, hizmet, yüksek mevki ve şeref, kötülükte ise önceden işlenmiş olumsuzluk olarak görünür. Kişi adlarında önderlik ve başta bulunma da bu alana bağlanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kadının yasak cinsel ilişkiden uzak durmasını ve cinsel organını korumasını dalın kurucu anlamı olarak açıkça verir. Evlilik yalnız başına bu dalı tanımlamaz; evlilikle doğan hukuki durum ayrı dalda tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Niteleyici ve eylemsel biçimler ortak cinsel özdenetim çekirdeğinde buluşur; cinsel organı koruma yapısı kendi bağlamında tutulur ve yalın kök anlamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kadının yasak cinsel ilişkiden uzak durarak kendisini ve cinsel organını kuşkudan ve ihlalden korumasıdır. Niteleyici biçimler, bu özdenetimi kalıcı bir kadın niteliği olarak sunar.

facets.statement: Kadın, yasak cinsel ilişkiden uzak durur ve cinsel organını bu tür ilişkiden korur.
